# Capacitor Auth Manager

> Google sign-in for Capacitor and the web. Documentation for 3.0.0; Google is the only enabled provider. Firebase is managed by the consuming app.

## Integration contract

Web One-Tap returns an ID token; web popup returns an access token; auto may return either. Native sign-in returns an ID token. Firebase handoff: GoogleAuthProvider.credential(idToken ?? null, accessToken ?? null). Call auth.prepare(AuthProvider.GOOGLE) before enabling a click handler. Firebase onAuthStateChanged owns protected routes. The package does not verify JWT signatures.

## Machine-readable documentation

- [AI integration guide](https://capacitor-auth-manager-docs.aoneahsan.com/raw/integration/ai.md): exact imports, setup, Firebase session lifecycle, errors, platform requirements, and acceptance checks.
- [Raw Markdown manifest](https://capacitor-auth-manager-docs.aoneahsan.com/raw/manifest.json): release version and raw URL for every published page.
- [Full documentation](https://capacitor-auth-manager-docs.aoneahsan.com/llms-full.txt): all published pages as plain text.
